Launch Interactive scSimEval Benchmarking Studio

Source: R/launch_app.R
launch_scSimEval_app.Rd

Launches the companion Shiny web application bundled in scSimEvalStudio. Provides a graphical interface to upload SingleCellExperiment biological reference and simulated datasets (scRNA-seq, scATAC-seq, paired or unpaired multiomics), execute the 56-measure evaluation suite across 8 canonical categories, explore diagnostic figures interactively, and export publication-quality figures, standalone HPC R scripts, and Excel/PDF reports.

Usage

launch_scSimEval_app(
  port = NULL,
  host = "127.0.0.1",
  launch.browser = interactive(),
  maxRequestSize = 10 * 1024^3
)

Arguments

port

Optional port number for the local web server. Default is NULL (random open port).

host

Character string specifying the IP address to listen on. Defaults to "127.0.0.1".

launch.browser

Logical, whether to automatically open the default web browser. Defaults to interactive().

maxRequestSize

Numeric maximum upload file size in bytes. Defaults to 10 * 1024^3 (10 GiB).

Value

A shiny.appobj returned invisibly when shiny::runApp() exits cleanly.

Details

The interactive scSimEvalStudio web application organizes single-cell and multiomics simulation benchmarking into 8 modular navigation tabs:

  1. Home: Executive KPI dashboard and overview of the 8 canonical evaluation categories (56 curated measures).
  2. Data Hub: Supports 4 data ingestion modes: (1) unimodal scRNA-seq (44 active measures across 7 categories), (2) unimodal scATAC-seq (38 active measures across 6 categories), (3) paired and unpaired Single-Cell Multiomics (all 56 measures across 8 categories), and (4) pre-computed benchmark session archives (.rds / .csv). Includes 1-click Oryza sativa Rice Bud and Glycine max Soybean Root empirical benchmarks and a 1-click standalone HPC/Workstation R script generator.
  3. Comparative Bubble Matrix: Dual-encoded visual ranking figure (scSimEval::plot_benchmark_bubble_matrix()) and interactive Fidelity Leaderboard (scSimEval::compute_method_leaderboard()).
  4. Visualizations: Eight diagnostic sub-panels (Evaluation Summary, Distribution QC across 18 empirical properties, Metric Heatmap, Metric Plots, PCA Ordination anchored to the Ideal Reference Anchor 1, MDS Metric Space, Cell Embeddings [UMAP, t-SNE, PCA with ASW and ARI], and Scalability Benchmark [core_seconds and MiB/core]), all equipped with a 25%–400% interactive step-zoom, drag-to-pan, and 600% fullscreen lightbox viewer.
  5. Benchmark Results & Export: Reproducible .rds session export, filterable DT master table (Score_Raw and direction-aligned Score in [0, 1]), and multi-sheet Excel (.xlsx) and .csv exports.
  6. Help & Getting Started: Interactive workflow diagrams, S4 SingleCellExperiment preparation recipes, and dynamic BiocParallel multi-core scheduling guidelines.
  7. Logs: Real-time WebSocket diagnostic console streaming INFO, NOTE, WARNING, ERROR, and SUCCESS events.
  8. Contact: Institutional attribution and research team directory at the Division of Agricultural Bioinformatics, ICAR-IASRI, New Delhi.

See also

scSimEval::evaluate_simulation_accuracy(), scSimEval::evaluate_multiomics_accuracy(), scSimEval::normalize_bubble_scores(), scSimEval::plot_benchmark_bubble_matrix()

Examples

app_dir <- system.file("shiny", "scSimEvalApp", package = "scSimEvalStudio")
nzchar(app_dir)
#> [1] TRUE
if (interactive()) {
  launch_scSimEval_app()
}
